projects.name: Ausbildung in Germany
projects.goal: Start a dual vocational training (Ausbildung) in Germany
projects.done: A signed training contract and the D visa in my passport

tasks.t: Shortlist 3 to 5 Ausbildung courses (IT application development, system integration, mechatronics) and write why for each
Check your certificates on ANABIN and note what needs recognition
Write your German CV (Lebenslauf): tabular, reverse chronological, 1 to 2 pages
Write a first Motivationsschreiben draft in German, one page, 3 to 4 paragraphs
Order certified German translations of your 10th and 12th certificates
Build a list of 20 to 30 target companies on ausbildung.de, LinkedIn and company career pages
Build a portfolio of 5 to 10 pieces (only if you aim at game, VFX or design roles)
Send applications, batch 1: 5 companies with a customised letter each
Send applications, batch 3: up to 5 more (15 to 25 in total)
Practise 10 common interview questions in German out loud
Check each training contract: IHK or HWK stamp, stipend, start date, vocational school
Collect the visa documents on the embassy checklist (Form 2, photos, insurance, contract)
Check the money rule: stipend below the minimum needs a blocked account or a sponsor
Arrange health insurance from the start date
Book the embassy appointment and submit the national D visa application
Arrange accommodation (ask about a company dorm) and open a German bank account
